description: Attach footnote texts to their in-text markers from page layout coordinates — Given footnote markers (label, page, x, y) and footnote texts (label, page, x, y) extracted from a laid-out document, pairs each marker with its note by label and page, pairing repeated labels on one page in reading order, optionally letting a note continue on the next page, and reports unattached markers, orphan notes, ambiguous groups (different counts for the same label) and notes placed above

allowNextPage.description: A note may sit on the page after its marker. Default false.

text.description: Context around the marker, echoed back.

label.description: Label as printed in the note.

yAxis.description: Direction of increasing y: down (PDF.js, screen) or up (PDF user space). Default down.

name: footnote-attach
